sentences.en: I'm made from recycled plastic. Please reuse or recycle me!
sentences.zh: 我由回收塑料制成。请重复使用或再次循环利用我！

sentences.en: You know this textbook is made of recycled paper.
sentences.zh: 你知道这本书是由再生纸制成的。

sentences.en: I only buy toilet paper made from recycled paper.
sentences.zh: 我只买由再生纸制成的卫生纸。

senses.zh: 再循环；“recycle”的过去式和过去分词
